mapper.insert: /** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.insertCatalogMng */ INSERT INTO G_CATALOG_MNG ( CATALOG_YEAR, CATALOG_NO, DISPLAY_YN, FRST_REGISTER_ID, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID ) VALUES ( #{catalogYearStr}, #{catalogNoStr}, #{displayYn}, #{userId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.select: /** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectCatalogMngYearList */ SELECT CATALOG_YEAR , CATALOG_NO FROM G_CATALOG_MNG GROUP BY CATALOG_YEAR ORDER BY CATALOG_YEAR DESC
/** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectCatalogMngNoList */ SELECT DISTINCT CATALOG_NO FROM G_CATALOG_MNG WHERE CATALOG_YEAR = #{catalogYear} ORDER BY CATALOG_NO DESC

/** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectNewRgstItemMng */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SUB_CATALOG_YEAR , SEARCH_START_MONTH , SEARCH_END_MONTH
, I.ITEM_ID , I.SELLER_ID , I.ITEM_CODE , I.ITEM_USER_CODE , I.ITEM_NAME , I.ITEM_SUMMARY , I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE , I.ITEM_TYPE , I.ITEM_NEW_FLAG , I.ITEM_LABEL , I.ITEM_TYPE1 , I.ITEM_TYPE2 , I.ITEM_TYPE3 , I.ITEM_TYPE4 , I.ITEM_TYPE5 , I.ITEM_TYPE6 , I.ITEM_TYPE7 , I.ITEM_TYPE8 , I.ITEM_TYPE9 , I.ITEM_TYPE10 , I.BRAND_ID , I.BRAND , I.SOLD_OUT , I.STOCK_FLAG , I.STOCK_QUANTITY , I.NONMEMBER_ORDER_TYPE , I.TAX_TYPE , I.COMMISSION_TYPE , I.COMMISSION_RATE , I.PRICE_CRITERIA
, I.ITEM_PRICE , I.COST_PRICE , I.SUPPLY_PRICE , I.SALE_PRICE , I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER_FLAG , I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER
, I.ADULT_ITEM_YN , I.MOBILE_ITEM_YN
, I.SPOT_FLAG , I.SPOT_DATE_TYPE , I.SPOT_TYPE , I.SPOT_APPLY_GROUP , I.SPOT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.SPOT_START_DATE , I.SPOT_END_DATE , I.SPOT_START_TIME , I.SPOT_END_TIME , I.SPOT_WEEK_DAY
, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_FLAG , I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_TYPE , I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.SELLER_POINT_FLAG
, I.SET_DISCOUNT_TYPE , I.SET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.ITEM_IMAGE , I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG , I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE1 , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE2 , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE3 , I.DATA_STATUS_CODE , I.DISPLAY_FLAG , I.COUPON_USE_FLAG , I.NAVER_SHOPPING_ITEM_NAME , I.NAVER_SHOPPING_FLAG , I.NAVER_PAY_FLAG
, I.PRIVATE_TYPE , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , I.REPRESENTATIVE_ITEM_YN , I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG , I.ORIGIN_COUNTRY , I.MANUFACTURER , I.COLOR , I.WEIGHT , I.SALE_POINT
, I.STOCK_CODE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT , I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY , I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY , I.SALE_QUANTITY
, I.ITEM_ADDITION_FLAG , I.FREE_GIFT_FLAG , I.FREE_GIFT_NAME , I.ITEM_KEYWORD , I.ITEM_NOTICE_CODE , I.TEAM , I.OPENTIME , I.OTHER_FLAG , I.RECOMMEND_FLAG , I.RELATION_ITEM_DISPLAY_TYPE , I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_ID , I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME , I.DELIVERY_TYPE , I.ITEM_RETURN_FLAG , I.HITS
, I.MD_ID , I.MD_NAME
, I.SHIPPING_TYPE , I.SHIPPING , I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT
, I.UPDATED_USER_ID , I.UPDATED_DATE , I.CREATED_USER_ID , I.CREATED_DATE , I.ERP_EXCEPTION_TYPE
, I.ITEM_SELLER_CODE , ( CASE WHEN I.SOLD_OUT = '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'N' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE = 'T' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS ITEM_SOLD_OUT_FLAG , IFNULL(IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, 'N') AS ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG , IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_ITEM_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'), 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT , ROUND(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SCORE) / COUNT(*) FROM OP_ITEM_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'), 0),1) AS REVIEW_SCORE
, S.SELLER_NAME , S.LOGIN_ID AS SELLER_LOGIN_ID , S.COMPANY_NAME AS SELLER_COMPANY_NAME , S.COMMISSION_RATE AS SELLER_COMMISSION_RATE FROM OP_ITEM I INNER JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY C ON IC.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY_GROUP G ON C.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID = G.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID AND G.CATEGORY_GROUP_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT IOST ON I.ITEM_ID = IOST.ITEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON S.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT SUB_CATALOG_YEAR , CASE WHEN 1 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 3 THEN '01' WHEN 4 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 6 THEN '04' WHEN 7 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 9 THEN '07' WHEN 10 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 12 THEN '10' ELSE '99' END AS SEARCH_START_MONTH , CASE WHEN 1 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 3 THEN '03' WHEN 4 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 6 THEN '06' WHEN 7 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 9 THEN '09' WHEN 10 <= CATALOG_MONTH AND CATALOG_MONTH <= 12 THEN '12' ELSE '99' END AS SEARCH_END_MONTH FROM ( SELECT CAST(CATALOG_YEAR AS VARCHAR) AS SUB_CATALOG_YEAR , MONTH(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) AS CATALOG_MONTH FROM G_CATALOG_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND CATALOG_YEAR = #{catalogYear} AND CATALOG_NO = #{catalogNo} AND DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' ) ) SUB ON 1=1 WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1' AND I.DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE = '1' AND I.ITEM_TYPE IN ('1', '3') AND I.PRIVATE_TYPE IN ('000')
AND L.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
AND L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{upperLocgovCode}
AND I.ITEM_USER_CODE NOT IN (
#{item}
)
GROUP BY I.ITEM_ID ) T_A WHERE 1=1 AND T_A.CREATED_DATE BETWEEN CONCAT(SUB_CATALOG_YEAR, SEARCH_START_MONTH, '01000000') AND CONCAT(SUB_CATALOG_YEAR, SEARCH_END_MONTH, '99999999') ORDER BY RANDOM()

/** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectSeasonCatalogItemMng */
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT I.ITEM_ID , CATALOG_MONTH , SFI.SEASON_FOOD_MONTH , I.SELLER_ID , I.ITEM_CODE , I.ITEM_USER_CODE , I.ITEM_NAME , I.ITEM_SUMMARY , I.ITEM_DATA_TYPE , I.ITEM_TYPE , I.ITEM_NEW_FLAG , I.ITEM_LABEL , I.ITEM_TYPE1 , I.ITEM_TYPE2 , I.ITEM_TYPE3 , I.ITEM_TYPE4 , I.ITEM_TYPE5 , I.ITEM_TYPE6 , I.ITEM_TYPE7 , I.ITEM_TYPE8 , I.ITEM_TYPE9 , I.ITEM_TYPE10 , I.BRAND_ID , I.BRAND , I.SOLD_OUT , I.STOCK_FLAG , I.STOCK_QUANTITY , I.NONMEMBER_ORDER_TYPE , I.TAX_TYPE , I.COMMISSION_TYPE , I.COMMISSION_RATE , I.PRICE_CRITERIA
, I.ITEM_PRICE , I.COST_PRICE , I.SUPPLY_PRICE , I.SALE_PRICE , I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER_FLAG , I.SALE_PRICE_NONMEMBER
, I.ADULT_ITEM_YN , I.MOBILE_ITEM_YN
, I.SPOT_FLAG , I.SPOT_DATE_TYPE , I.SPOT_TYPE , I.SPOT_APPLY_GROUP , I.SPOT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.SPOT_START_DATE , I.SPOT_END_DATE , I.SPOT_START_TIME , I.SPOT_END_TIME , I.SPOT_WEEK_DAY
, I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_FLAG , I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_TYPE , I.SELLER_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.SELLER_POINT_FLAG
, I.SET_DISCOUNT_TYPE , I.SET_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT , I.ITEM_IMAGE , I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG , I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE1 , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE2 , I.ITEM_OPTION_TITLE3 , I.DATA_STATUS_CODE , I.DISPLAY_FLAG , I.COUPON_USE_FLAG , I.NAVER_SHOPPING_ITEM_NAME , I.NAVER_SHOPPING_FLAG , I.NAVER_PAY_FLAG
, I.PRIVATE_TYPE , L.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM || ' ' || L.LOCGOV_NM AS LOCGOV_NM , I.REPRESENTATIVE_ITEM_YN , I.MINOR_ALLOW_FLAG , I.ORIGIN_COUNTRY , I.MANUFACTURER , I.COLOR , I.WEIGHT , I.SALE_POINT
, I.STOCK_CODE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_AUTO_FLAG , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TYPE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_DATE , I.STOCK_SCHEDULE_TEXT , I.ORDER_MIN_QUANTITY , I.ORDER_MAX_QUANTITY , I.SALE_QUANTITY
, I.ITEM_ADDITION_FLAG , I.FREE_GIFT_FLAG , I.FREE_GIFT_NAME , I.ITEM_KEYWORD , I.ITEM_NOTICE_CODE , I.TEAM , I.OPENTIME , I.OTHER_FLAG , I.RECOMMEND_FLAG , I.RELATION_ITEM_DISPLAY_TYPE , I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_ID , I.DELIVERY_COMPANY_NAME , I.DELIVERY_TYPE , I.ITEM_RETURN_FLAG , I.HITS
, I.MD_ID , I.MD_NAME
, I.SHIPPING_TYPE , I.SHIPPING , I.SHIPPING_FREE_AMOUNT
, I.UPDATED_USER_ID , I.UPDATED_DATE , I.CREATED_USER_ID , I.CREATED_DATE , I.ERP_EXCEPTION_TYPE
, I.ITEM_SELLER_CODE , ( CASE WHEN I.SOLD_OUT = '1' THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'N' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.ITEM_OPTION_TYPE = 'T' AND I.STOCK_FLAG = 'Y' AND I.STOCK_QUANTITY = 0 THEN 'Y' WHEN I.ITEM_OPTION_FLAG = 'Y' AND IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS ITEM_SOLD_OUT_FLAG , IFNULL(IOST.ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG, 'N') AS ITEM_OPTION_SOLD_OUT_FLAG , IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM OP_ITEM_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'), 0) AS REVIEW_COUNT , ROUND(IFNULL((SELECT SUM(SCORE) / COUNT(*) FROM OP_ITEM_REVIEW WHERE ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID AND DISPLAY_FLAG = 'Y'), 0),1) AS REVIEW_SCORE
, S.SELLER_NAME , S.LOGIN_ID AS SELLER_LOGIN_ID , S.COMPANY_NAME AS SELLER_COMPANY_NAME , S.COMMISSION_RATE AS SELLER_COMMISSION_RATE FROM OP_ITEM I JOIN G_SEASON_FOOD_ITEM SFI ON I.ITEM_ID = SFI.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_ITEM_CATEGORY IC ON I.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY C ON IC.CATEGORY_ID = C.CATEGORY_ID AND C.CATEGORY_FLAG = 'Y' INNER JOIN OP_CATEGORY_GROUP G ON C.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID = G.CATEGORY_GROUP_ID AND G.CATEGORY_GROUP_FLAG = 'Y' LEFT JOIN OP_ITEM_OPTION_SOLDOUT IOST ON I.ITEM_ID = IOST.ITEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_SELLER S ON I.SELLER_ID = S.SELLER_ID AND S.STATUS_CODE = '2' LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV L ON S.LOCGOV_CODE = L.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT MONTH(FRST_REGIST_PNTTM) AS CATALOG_MONTH FROM G_CATALOG_MNG WHERE 1=1 AND CATALOG_YEAR = #{catalogYear} AND CATALOG_NO = #{catalogNo} AND DISPLAY_YN = 'Y' ) SUB ON 1=1 WHERE 1=1 AND I.DATA_STATUS_CODE = '1'
AND L.LOCGOV_CODE = #{locgovCode}
AND L.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE = #{upperLocgovCode}
AND I.ITEM_USER_CODE NOT IN (
#{item}
)
) T_A WHERE 1=1 AND CASE WHEN CATALOG_MONTH IN (1, 2, 3) THEN SEASON_FOOD_MONTH IN (3, 4, 5) WHEN CATALOG_MONTH IN (4, 5, 6) THEN SEASON_FOOD_MONTH IN (6, 7, 8) WHEN CATALOG_MONTH IN (7, 8, 9) THEN SEASON_FOOD_MONTH IN (9, 10, 11) WHEN CATALOG_MONTH IN (10, 11, 12) THEN SEASON_FOOD_MONTH IN (12, 1, 2) ELSE 0=1 END GROUP BY T_A.ITEM_ID ORDER BY RANDOM()
/** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectCardNewsImgDesc */ SELECT CARD_NEWS_ID , IMG_DESC , IMG_SEQ FROM G_CATALOG_CARD_NEWS_IMG_DESC WHERE CARD_NEWS_ID = #{cardNewsId} ORDER BY IMG_SEQ

/** saleson.shop.catalog.CatalogMngMapper.selectCatalogContentImgDesc */ SELECT CATALOG_CONTENT_ID , IMG_DESC , IMG_SEQ FROM G_CATALOG_CONTENT_IMG_DESC WHERE CATALOG_CONTENT_ID = #{catalogContentId} ORDER BY IMG_SEQ
